entries.19a35d2616c968ec: An accommodation business in which consolidated subsidiary Ebisu Ryokan Co., Ltd. operates a 9-room accommodation-specialized hotel near Kyoto Station and sells reservations mainly to foreign tourists. In Asakusa and Kyoto, development of new hotels is also progressing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥31 million.
entries.59e91eaf8074bdf4: An online travel business centered on cruises. The company sells domestic and overseas cruise tickets, package tours and domestic travel, and consolidated subsidiary Five Star Cruise Co., Ltd. sells cruise travel exclusively on luxury ships. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥2,875 million.
entries.885ed300bc55b934: An online travel company that, centered on cruise travel, sells domestic and international cruise tickets, package tours and domestic travel over the internet.
entries.a36b1e9360071e4b: Individual customers considering cruise travel or domestic travel
entries.c7855ee8e45833cd: A travel company specializing in luxury cruise ships, operated by consolidated subsidiary Five Star Cruise Co., Ltd. Sells only suites on luxury liners and other passenger ships to affluent and senior customers.
entries.f4e8eaf8d4398672: An online booking site operated by the company, where domestic and overseas cruise tickets and package tours can be searched and booked. The company also sells domestic travel such as bus tours, hotels, domestic tours and dynamic packages, and for foreign visitors to Japan, sells cruises departing from and arriving in Japan overseas and develops domestic sightseeing products.
